newsitem.title: KENYA: T-bill rates eases again at latest Kenyan auction.
newsitem.headline: T-bill rates eases again at latest Kenyan auction.

text.p: Treasury bill rates eased again at this week's auction by the Central Bank of Kenya, the bank said on Friday.

The central bank said it offered an average interest rate of 21.689 percent on its main 91-day treasury bill category compared to 21.800 last week while on the 28-day category it offered 15.629, marginally down from 15.953 last week.
Out of the total 5.211 billion shillings tendered in bills, the bank said it accepted 4.742 billion shillings. The bank had invited tenders worth 10 billion shillings in treasury bills.
In the 28-day category, the bank accepted 42.15 million shillings, while on the 91-day category, it accepted some 4.6 billion shillings.
In the 182-day category, the bank accepted 1.45 million shillings, but did not say what rate it offered.
The bank invited tenders for 8.0 billion shillings for the next auction on December 5.
